verdict.rationale: Platform event webhooks are a fair question for a cloud platform like Fly.io, so the axis applies. The pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for Fly.io events. The only webhook-related item (a Laravel blog post) is about the user's own app receiving incoming webhooks while hosted on Fly, which is a user-side workload rather than a platform event subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
